categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the HVLS (High-Volume, Low-Speed) fan industry, focusing on the research, production, sales, installation, and related technical services of large industrial fans. Additionally, it has expanded into lithium battery application technologies, including commercial and industrial energy storage, light power battery packs, and UPS backup power for 5G base stations and data centers. The company is also strategically developing artificial intelligence (AI) applications in smart office, smart healthcare, and smart mobility sectors through its joint venture, Henan Yuzhi Kale Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include permanent magnet synchronous motor technology, innovative blade design, advanced safety design concepts, and new vector controller technology. It employs both asynchronous and permanent magnet synchronous motor-driven HVLS fans, with IoT-enabled smart controllers and cloud platforms for intelligent monitoring and control. Production is mainly self-operated with some outsourced machining, emphasizing quality control, environmental sustainability, and cost efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily from industrial manufacturing, warehousing logistics, commercial buildings, and public facilities such as sports venues, schools, and hospitals. The lithium battery segment serves clients in commercial and industrial energy storage, light electric vehicles, robotics, and 5G infrastructure. The company targets both domestic Chinese markets and international markets, including Southeast Asia, India, Mexico, the Middle East, Europe, and North America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production facilities in Shanghai and subsidiaries in Suzhou, Zhejiang, and other domestic locations. It has established overseas subsidiaries in India, Mexico, and Singapore to expand its global footprint, focusing on emerging markets in Asia, Latin America, and developed markets in Europe and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembling HVLS fans and lithium battery systems. It sources key components such as motors, blades, and battery cells from suppliers but controls core technology development and final product assembly. It also provides installation and after-sales services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening R&D in HVLS fan technology, expanding lithium battery application solutions, and accelerating AI-driven digital transformation. The company invests heavily in product innovation, IoT integration, and smart control systems, with ongoing projects in lightweight motor development, multi-functional industrial fans, and AI applications in smart office, healthcare, and mobility. It aims to enhance product competitiveness, operational efficiency, and global market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of HVLS fans, lithium battery systems, and related components. Additional income streams include installation and after-sales service fees, distributed photovoltaic power station investment and operation, and leasing income. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income from equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the HVLS fan industry with a strong market share and recognized brand. It competes with numerous domestic and international manufacturers but distinguishes itself through patented technologies and comprehensive service capabilities. In lithium battery applications and AI sectors, it is building competitive advantages through innovation and strategic partnerships, aiming to capture growing market opportunities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 331 million, a 10.14% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 10.53 million. Total assets stood at around RMB 958 million, showing a slight decline. Despite short-term profit pressures due to market demand contraction and increased strategic investments, the company maintains a solid asset base and is investing in growth areas to drive future expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes energy-efficient, large-scale ventilation solutions with superior airflow, low noise, and smart IoT-enabled controls that improve indoor air quality and human comfort. Its lithium battery products offer high safety, reliability, and customization for diverse applications. The integration of AI technologies into traditional manufacturing and new business areas provides differentiated intelligent solutions, enhancing customer value through innovation, quality, and comprehensive service.
